planets.name: GJ 238 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of GJ 238 with a 1.74-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: GJ 238 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around GJ 238. Its orbit and size follow Tey et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
